transcript:
Stress is a response to demands or difficult circumstances. People respond differently, and circumstances affect what is possible.

A next step might be practical help, connection or a coping activity. You do not have to choose the same option as someone else.

Gentle breathing is optional. Follow comfortable, unforced instructions if you try it. Research does not establish a guaranteed nervous-system reset.

Persistent difficulties deserve appropriate support. These illustrations do not measure hormones, diagnose symptoms or replace professional care.
